title: unity / Set up Unity
content:
## Set up Unity

### Update the Visual Studio Package

The Unity extension for {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} depends on the `Visual Studio Editor` Unity Package. In Unity, open up **Windows**, **Packages**. Make sure the `Visual Studio Editor` package is upgraded to `2.0.20` or above.

![Unity Package Manager](images/unity/unity-packagemanager.png)

> **Note**: The `{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} Editor` package published by Unity is a legacy package from Unity that is not maintained anymore.
